text:
Maria Gomez: Quick sync — planning a community hands-on workshop + 30-min webinar to launch the OSS refapp. Target week: Jun 7-11. Need assets, a short benchmark story, and inbound lead routing.

Alex Turner: Live webinar for Q&A + a 10-min recorded demo we can embed. I can demo the deploy step.

Samir Patel: Live works. I9ll own the customer examples (search, summarization, chat ops) and the registration copy.

Jin Park: Adding a tiny perf job in CI to emit median/p95/p99 and cost/token for our sample prompts. Will attach JSON artifact. ETA: Wed.

Olivia Chen: Design can do a hero banner + two social thumbs. Need staging URL and 3 screenshots.

Alex Turner: Tutorial flow I9ll write: install, run locally, deploy to staging, enable caching, view metrics. Tiny code snippet for the blog: 
```
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
print(client.generate('Summarize this repo in one sentence'))
```

Maria Gomez: Routing: form -> Intercom + calendar invite, tag leads "oss-refapp-june", notify SDRs in #sales. Samir, confirm required fields?

Samir Patel: Required: company, work email, role, est. monthly inference volume, primary cloud. Optional: compliance checkbox. Also checkbox: want Dedicated demo?

Jin Park: CI will publish a reproducibility blurb and the command: `make ci-benchmark SAMPLE_PROMPTS=prompts/customer_support.json`. Will note machine spec and model variant.

Olivia Chen: CTAs for post: try demo, clone tutorial repo, register for webinar. Include anchor to benchmark section.

Alex Turner: I9ll rehearse with Jin so staging perf is stable. Please stash demo creds in 1Password.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Staging demo deployed at https://staging-refapp.redwood.example 9 creds in 1Password under "refapp-staging-demo".

Maria Gomez: Ops timeline: draft blog + tutorial by May 24, design assets by May 28, webinar page live June 1, rehearsals June 5, webinar June 9. I9ll share a short checklist and invite for a run-through tomorrow 9am PT. :thumbsup:
